title: 10년 뒤 편지
scene: 어학당 졸업식. 10년 뒤에 열어 볼 편지를 쓰기로 했다

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Let's open them together in ten years. Promise.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: How old will we be in ten years?

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: I'll be 34. Probably a team leader.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Then will your "anything" mean samgyeopsal too?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Secret. But I'll tell you one thing.

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 너 처음 왔을 때 「밥 먹었어?」에 진짜 밥 먹자고 한 거.
turns.rd: neo cheoeum wasseul ttae 「bap meogeosseo?」e jinjja bap meokjago han geo.
turns.en: When you first came and took "did you eat?" literally.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yeah. That's when we became friends.

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: For me it was when you got the "army talk" joke.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Those mistakes are all our memories.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 그럼 10년 뒤에는 실수 없이 한국어로 읽어 줄게.
turns.rd: geureom 10nyeon dwieneun silsu eopsi hangugeoro ilgeo julge.
turns.en: Then in ten years I'll read it to you in Korean without mistakes.

turns.speaker: C
turns.en: If you get it wrong, you buy chicken.
